anti_toolbox_hits.justification: Donor signature (Palette button radius 25px on 50px) — pinned by fidelity: close.

brand_faithful_inversions: pure-white retention: #ffffff kept as page ground (Palette mono0, the gallery-wall ground of the design source). The 'no pure black/white' impeccable rule is inverted per brand-faithful direction.
pure-black retention: #000000 kept as primary text and primary button fill (Palette mono100). The 'no pure black/white' rule is inverted per brand-faithful direction.
hex format retention: colour tokens kept in hex, matching @artsy/palette-tokens. OKLCH applies to new authoring; this is inheritance.
sharp 0px corner retention: images, cards, panels and messages stay square (Palette). The rounded-card reflex is inverted.
saturated colour retention: ultramarine #1023d7 kept as the single state colour (Palette brand). The tinted-neutral reflex is inverted.

brand_adjacent_refinements.what: field and pill border at rest: plaster #c2c2c2 → graphite #707070
brand_adjacent_refinements.why: plaster on white is 1.78:1, below WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 for component boundaries; graphite is 4.95:1 and is itself a Palette token
Unica77 LL is commercially licensed; user chose an open look-alike

narrative.overview: Artsy's Palette system adopted closely for SMK's open collection: monochrome chrome, one grotesque at one weight, ultramarine only for state. SMK's colour data and the artworks are the only colour on the page.
keyCharacteristics: hierarchy by size and tracking at weight 400

rules.name: The Data Colour Rule
rules.body: SMK palette colours appear only as data; never in chrome.

rules.name: The One State Colour Rule
rules.body: Ultramarine means focused, hovered or chosen, always with a non-colour cue.

rules.name: One Weight Rule
rules.body: Headings at 400; 500 only for emphasis in small text.

dos: Let artworks and colour data carry the colour
Label every colour with name and hex
donts: No tinted chrome or second accent
No Artsy logo, name or copy
